page_title: WebExtract — web page to structured JSON: product, tables, metadata

sources.entry: WebExtract - Turns one web page into Markdown or structured JSON, as a REST API or a remote MCP server (https://api.webextract.dev/mcp); the first 20 calls a day per IP are free, then pay per call in USDC over x402 or with prepaid credits. #freemium #api #mcp

summary.name: WebExtract
summary.one_liner: A REST API and remote MCP server that turns any web page into clean Markdown plus fixed-schema JSON (product/price, tables, metadata) for AI agents and RAG pipelines.
use_cases: Feed clean page content into a RAG pipeline
Let an AI agent read a URL via MCP
Extract product name and price from a product page
Pull HTML tables into structured rows
Get article title, author and publish date from a page
Convert a web page to Markdown for LLM prompts
summary.what_it_does: WebExtract fetches a URL and returns the main content as Markdown, with navigation, ads and scripts stripped and tables converted to GFM tables. The /v1/extract endpoint also returns a fixed-schema JSON with product fields (name, brand, SKU/GTIN, price, currency, availability, rating), tables with row and column counts, and metadata such as title, authors, dates, canonical URL and language. /v1/markdown returns only Markdown, title and word count at a lower price. It is available as a REST API, a remote streamable-HTTP MCP server with extract_url and page_markdown tools, and SDKs for Python and npm, plus LangChain and Vercel AI SDK helpers. Pages are fetched as raw HTML without running JavaScript, and the crawler respects robots.txt and does not bypass CAPTCHAs.
notable: Fixed JSON schema across sites, with price_detail that reports unresolved prices with a reason instead of 0
Pay-per-call in USDC via x402 with no account, plus prepaid Stripe credits that never expire
Remote MCP server listed in the official MCP Registry
No charge for failed fetches (404, timeout, blocked, robots.txt disallowed)
caveats: Does not run JavaScript yet, so client-rendered pages may return thin content
Free tier limited to 20 calls per day per IP; beyond that, paid prepaid credits or x402 USDC are needed
x402 payments are not on Ethereum mainnet and the sandbox only uses Base Sepolia test USDC
